items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Because I remember I even did a thing with his band, and it was on the north side someplace.

ctx.x: His band was integrated. And he worked on the north side and places like that. Because I remember I even did a thing with his band, and it was on the north side someplace. We didn’t have necessarily, except the part where I remember we had any clubs that necessarily had big bands. Everything was combos. The big bands were for dancing and stuff like that.
I was interested in, you said one of the first times you saw Joe Williams he was dressed in a clown outfit.
